source: ONS Price Index of Private Rents, local authority level

fields.rent: average monthly private rent, all homes, 2026-09 (pounds)
fields.rent1Bed: average monthly private rent, one-bedroom homes (pounds)
fields.rent2Bed: average monthly private rent, two-bedroom homes (pounds)
fields.rent3Bed: average monthly private rent, three-bedroom homes (pounds)
fields.rent4Bed: average monthly private rent, four or more bedrooms (pounds)
fields.annualChange: change in private rents over the last 12 months (%)
fields.regionRent: average monthly private rent in West Midlands (pounds)
fields.regionRent1Bed: average monthly private rent, one-bedroom homes, West Midlands (pounds)
fields.regionRent2Bed: average monthly private rent, two-bedroom homes, West Midlands (pounds)
fields.regionRent3Bed: average monthly private rent, three-bedroom homes, West Midlands (pounds)
fields.regionAnnualChange: change in private rents over 12 months in West Midlands (%)
fields.englandRent: average monthly private rent in England (pounds)
fields.englandRent1Bed: average monthly private rent, one-bedroom homes, England (pounds)
fields.englandRent2Bed: average monthly private rent, two-bedroom homes, England (pounds)
fields.englandRent3Bed: average monthly private rent, three-bedroom homes, England (pounds)
fields.englandAnnualChange: change in private rents over 12 months in England (%)
